content:
# A small synthetic TOML fixture for the chunker corpus. ASCII-only.

[package]
name = "chunk-fixture"
version = "0.1.0"
edition = "2021"
description = "not a real package, only chunker corpus input"

[dependencies]
serde = { version = "1", features = ["derive"] }
thiserror = "1"
tree-sitter = "0.26"

[dev-dependencies]
proptest = "1"

[[bin]]
name = "fixture-one"
path = "src/bin/one.rs"

[[bin]]
name = "fixture-two"
path = "src/bin/two.rs"

[profile.release]
opt-level = 3
lto = true
codegen-units = 1

[profile.dev]
opt-level = 0
debug = true

[workspace]
members = ["crates/one", "crates/two", "crates/three"]

[workspace.metadata.fixture]
owner = "chunk-corpus"
note = "small and synthetic, not lifted from any real config file"

[[table_array]]
id = 1
name = "first"

[[table_array]]
id = 2
name = "second"

[[table_array]]
id = 3
name = "third"
